name: Robert Nugent
bio: Robert Nugent lost three horses to lightning in August 1886, and three more of his horses went with J. A. VanEeghen's car shipment to St. Cloud. In October 1886 he and Moses Rider were expected back from a trip to St. Cloud.

moments.label: Three of his horses killed by lightning

mentions: Last Thursday three horses belonging to Bob. Nugent were killed by lightning. Although he has about 250 horses in his herd, the loss is rather severe as the three were above the average in quality.
…learned that there was sale for that number from Lloyd Roberts, who is now there buying stock. Three of Bob. Nugent's horses were also shipped with the car.
Moses Rider and Robert Nugent are expected soon from their St. Cloud trip.
